claim.excerpt: Linear regression analyses between estimated and actual post-mortem intervals yielded low coefficients of determination, with R² = 34.1% for the TDS-based model and R² = 20.5% for the ADD-based model, indicating that both methods explain only a limited portion of the variance in the actual PMI (PMIa).

sources.title: Inter-operator reliability of the total decomposition score (TDS) method for estimating the post-mortem interval (PMI) in outdoor cases

why_it_matters: Limitations prevent over-interpretation of a finding.
